column1: # US forces stationed abroad, one installation per row.
# country: the host's nation id. base: a neutral label for the installation, never a unit designation.
# personnel_band: the published figure as a band: under 500, 500 to 1,000, 1,000 to 5,000, 5,000 to 15,000, 15,000 to 30,000, 30,000 to 60,000.
# Left out: Guam and Puerto Rico (US soil) and Diego Garcia (no host on the roster).

# anchor: sourced (a point from the record named in anchor_source, opened on anchor_opened) or zone-level (a country total, a rotation or a set of sites with no single location; drawn in the host's zone, never at an invented spot).
# lat, lon: decimal degrees, four places. Composite rows are split into one row per installation; a split row's personnel stay in the country total.
# source: the page the personnel row was read from. opened: the day it was read.
